title: Fix bundled library subpath serialization
author: harsh21234i

linked_issues.title: compile_app() discards user bundle_library() registrations, and the dynamic serializer never rewrites subpath imports of bundled libs

awaiting: masenf to respond to the author's detailed rebuttal of his trigger-scenario question
maintainer review (still no formal human review, only a plain comment)

outstanding_asks.ask: Can you explain what scenarios result in triggering this bug? Most situations that matter, like hot-reload, would end up re-bundling the needed libraries anyway.
outstanding_asks.evidence: harsh21234i replied 2026-09-05T12:06:35Z with a detailed rebuttal: the bug is not limited to hot-reload -- it also hits first compiles, cached app modules, compiler/AppHarness tests, and export/build paths where compile_app() resets bundled-library registrations without re-executing user registration code

recent_comments.excerpt: I agree that normal hot-reload may re-run the app module and re-register the library... The bug is not limited to source-file hot-reload though. The failure occurs when bundle_library() is called during app/component registration and compile_app() later resets the bundled-library list before compilation... Examples include repeated compilation in the same process, cached app modules, compiler/AppHarness tests, export/build paths, and dynamic component serialization.

can you explain what scenarios result in triggering this bug? i understand what's going on, but it seems like most situations that matter, like hot-reload would end up re-bundling the needed libraries anyway.
